comparisons.peer_topic: Methodology Differences and Capital Composition Definitions
comparisons.peer_summary: Total capital under Advanced approaches differs from Standardized due to Tier 2 capital allowances; total average assets reflect Tier 1 deductions, and capital composition includes CECL transition impacts and OCI hedging amounts.
comparisons.comparison: Both JPMorgan and Bank of America disclose the specific regulatory treatment of the allowance for credit losses (ACL) within Tier 2 capital, noting that the inclusion is subject to a cap relative to credit risk-weighted assets and involves CECL transition impacts. JPMorgan specifies the cap as 1.25% of credit risk RWA with excess deducted from RWA, while Bank of America explains that total capital under Advanced approaches differs from Standardized due to differences in the amount permitted in Tier 2 capital related to the qualifying ACL, confirming similar regulatory constraints on ACL inclusion.
